title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less

translated_title: Transformer语言模型中权重剪枝的机制性失效模式
translated_abstract: 剪枝后的语言模型几乎完全通过准确率和困惑度来评判，这隐含了一个假设：输出行为的保留意味着内部计算的保留。我们通过在GPT-2上进行的因子化剪枝研究来检验这一假设，交叉考察了两种重要性标准（幅度剪枝、随机剪枝）、两种组件类型（注意力头、MLP神经元）和三个稀疏度水平（3%、50%、70%）。以被完整表征的间接宾语识别（IOI）电路作为基准真值，我们使用激活修补、路径修补和直接logit归因来测量电路完整性。我们发现了两种性质截然不同的失效模式。幅度注意力头剪枝超过某一阈值会使电路完全归零：面向输出的注意力头被移除，模型性能降至接近随机水平。而30%的幅度神经元剪枝则呈现出相反的失效模式：所有26个电路注意力头均保持完好，但Name Mover（名称移动器）头的贡献符号发生翻转，导致模型系统性地偏好错误的名称（准确率仅17.7%）。困惑度将其评定为较……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究通过机制可解释性方法（激活修补、路径修补、直接logit归因）分析GPT-2剪枝后的IOI电路，揭示了两种截然不同的失效模式——幅度头剪枝直接移除关键电路头导致性能接近随机，而30%的神经元剪枝在电路结构完全保留的情况下翻转Name Mover头的贡献符号使模型系统性出错，且这种内部计算的反转无法被困惑度等传统评估指标察觉。
en_tdlr: Using mechanistic interpretability techniques (activation patching, path patching, and direct logit attribution) to analyze the IOI circuit in pruned GPT-2, this work identifies two qualitatively distinct failure modes: magnitude head pruning zeroes the circuit by removing output-facing heads, while 30% neuron pruning keeps all circuit heads intact but flips Name Mover sign contributions, causing systematic wrong-name preference that perplexity-based evaluation fails to detect.
